text:
Maya Chen: Quick thread 1  proposal: narrow Optimize Toolkit MVP to a tightly scoped pilot-grade "launchpad": adaptive batching (route opt-in), prefix KV cache, eval-triggered regression alerts, plus a lightweight "Quant Advisor" run offline (no auto-apply). Aim: a safe pilot we can confidently hand to 2-3 customers in ~10 days.

Diego Alvarez: +1 to a compact launchpad. Two asks from me: 1) explicit acceptance gates (econ, latency, alert fidelity), and 2) a clear rollback policy per-route. We should avoid surprises for SRE.

Priya Nair: From runtime: doable if we keep admission control minimal. I propose a default admission policy and a per-route override flag. Risks: batching interacts with autoscaling and token-cache eviction. We'll need a telemetry tag to correlate before/after token-cost per-request.

Ben Holt: Suggested measurable gates: econ: >=15% median token-cost reduction on pilot routes over a 7d window; latency: p95 user latency <= baseline +12%; alerting: seeded-regression precision >=80% and false positive rate <=10%. Add a 72h early-check: if econ improvement <8% on a route, auto-disable batching for that route and notify owners.

Sasha Kumar: Customer signal: pilots (MedNote, LedgerAI) asked for quant guidance. They'll accept an "experimental advisory" PDF that includes sample configs, confidence notes, and recommended eval prompts. They don't want automatic quant changes in prod. I'll own the advisory draft.

Maya Chen: Decision lean: runtime MVP = adaptive batching + prefix cache + eval alerts; Quant Advisor = offline job that outputs a human-reviewed PDF + config snippet (no auto-deploy). Action owners: Priya infra spike, Diego checklist, Sasha advisory, Ben econ dashboards.

Priya Nair: Spike plan: build small admission-control with these defaults:
```json
{"max_wait_ms": 25, "min_batch_size": 3, "prefer_latency_percentile": "p50", "per_route_flag": true}
```
We'll run synthetic traces -> tiny canary -> pilot. Need a feature-flag gate and per-tenant toggle.

ops-bot: Canary cluster provisioned in us-east-1: optimize-launchpad-canary x3 nodes. Monitoring: /d/optimize/launchpad-canary. Alerts posted to #eng-oncall.

Diego Alvarez: Rollback policy: per-route auto-disable on econ <8% after 72h OR p95 latency increase >10% in same window. Also manual rollback button in Console for owners. We should log the reason code so we can postmortem.

Ben Holt: Telemetry: create a lightweight econometrics tag "optimize.delta_v1" that captures token_count, cost_estimated_usd, route, tenant, before/after flags. Dashboards should show per-route deltas and a 72h summary. I'll wire that.

Sasha Kumar: Advisory format: 1) one-line verdict (safe / caution / not recommended), 2) recommended quant bits & per-layer notes, 3) confidence band, 4) 3 example prompts showing changed outputs, 5) evaluation prompts for customers to run locally. I'll label it experimental and include troubleshooting notes. ETA draft: Thu EOD.

Maya Chen: Operational gates summary to ship pilot: 1) bench econ & latency on 3 representative prompt sets (meet thresholds), 2) seeded-regression suite passes alert precision/FPR, 3) per-route UI toggle + rollback playbook, 4) Quant Advisor produces a PDF for at least one pilot tenant, 5) customer comms & opt-in for restricted/regulatory tenants.

Priya Nair: One more caution: for tenants with "regulatory" tag we should default batching OFF and require explicit customer opt-in. Sales flagged two pilots in that bucket. We should block-enable until legal signs off.

Diego Alvarez: Add that to the release gates. Also require a short runbook for SRE: steps to disable batching, how to interpret econ telemetry, and owner contacts.

Maya Chen: Timeline: Priya infra spike this week, Diego acceptance checklist by Wed, Ben dashboards by Thu, Sasha advisory by Thu EOD, pilot rollout target = ~10 days pending canary results.

Ben Holt: I'll prepare a small seeded-eval harness for alert precision testing and a dashboard with the 72h auto-rollback metric.

Priya Nair: I'll post the spike results and canary logs here. Need a tiny feature-flag for per-route toggles and an API to flip them.

Maya Chen: Final call: proceed with the launchpad MVP (adaptive batching + prefix cache + eval alerts) + offline Quant Advisor (experimental PDF only). Owners and dates agreed. We'll reconvene after the infra spike. :rocket:
